capabilities: Send HTTP requests with any method, headers, and body types
Inspect responses with JSON tree, JSONPath filter, and timing breakdown
Import collections from Postman, Insomnia, Bruno, HTTPie, Hoppscotch, curl, HAR, and .http files
Store collections as OpenCollection YAML files in the vault
Export collections as Postman JSON/YAML, cURL, HAR, or OpenCollection zip
disambiguation: Not a code formatter; it sends HTTP requests and formats JSON responses, not Markdown notes.
extras: Free and open source under MIT. Also available as a VS Code extension sharing the same YAML files. Desktop only, needs Obsidian 1.11.4 or later. No account, cloud, or telemetry; secrets kept in Obsidian's secret storage. Mobile support listed as coming next.
problem: Testing REST APIs normally means leaving Obsidian for a separate HTTP client, so requests and collections live outside the vault.
